rows.text: The release dated 25 May 2019 states that, exercising powers under Article 75(1), the President 'today appointed' Narendra Modi to the office of Prime Minister of India and asked him to advise the names of other ministers and to indicate the date and time of the swearing-in; Modi was formally intimated when he called on the President that day as leader of the BJP Parliamentary Party.
